title: 第959章 柳紫嫣 我缺的不是沉淀而是气运第958章 天渊殿抓詹台朵朵的真实目的
content_zh:
经过商量，林陌与詹台玄坤一致决定，等詹台玄坤稍微养好一些伤势，再攻入金龙天，对太古真龙族进行最后的清算。
反正太一界里的消息传不出去，再加上太古真龙族的高层基本上全都出动了。
因此，这里的消息，短时间内是传不回金龙天的。
随后，詹台玄坤派人清理了一下战场，收获了诸多太古真龙族强者身上的法宝、储物戒等战利品。
林陌只要了一件战利品。
那便是摩诃帝俊方才使用的那柄上品圣阶至宝的圣龙剑。
这是所有战利品当中最具有价值、最重量级的战利品。
所以，林陌也不多要。
“倒是还有一件事没搞明白，天渊殿打朵朵的主意究竟意欲何为？”见林陌实在不要战利品了，詹台玄坤也是揭过了这个话题，转而谈起了他与林陌心中共同的疑惑。
“我又不是特殊圣体拥有者，他们抓我作甚？”詹台朵朵本人也是一脸茫然。
“三足金乌血脉拥有者...”
柳紫嫣沉吟道：“从客观方面来说，你的三足金乌血脉的确具有不菲的价值，也许他们是要利用你的三足金乌血脉来炼丹，又或者是用来炼器。”
林陌不置可否地道：“问题是，就算三足金乌血脉能用来炼丹和炼器，可真的值得他们出动三位大乘期强者么？”
而且其中一位还是大乘后期的殒苍生。
“这个问题以后再说吧。”
见他们几人一起讨论也没能得出一个结果，詹台玄坤也不做过多纠结，“林小友，柳掌门，今天给你们添麻烦了，还请你们移步到我詹台府稍作歇息。”
因为这场灭族之劫的原因，太一界的城池基本上毁于一旦。
所幸，詹台府并未受到太多波及。
因此，提供给林陌和柳紫嫣落脚歇息的地方还是有的。
回到詹台府，林陌便让詹台玄坤先行养伤去了。

“朵朵仙子，你先去帮忙处理战后事宜吧，我也不是第一次来了，我和紫紫自便即可。”詹台朵朵本想替她父亲招待林陌和柳紫嫣的。
可对于林陌来说，有柳紫嫣在身边，他还不能那么肆意妄为。
不管怎么说，他也得考虑柳紫嫣的感受。
更何况，林陌还有事还问柳紫嫣，因此把詹台朵朵支开才是最好的选择。
“那...好吧，林陌道友，柳掌门，你们有事再叫我就好了，我先去帮忙。”收到林陌投来的眼神，詹台朵朵立即会意。
看着詹台朵朵远去的背影，柳紫嫣若有所思道：“上次在宁华宫见她，她似乎还只是寻常的涅盘天凤血脉吧？”
“一段时间没见，这位詹台朵朵居然还觉醒了三足金乌血脉，看来她的气运还挺不错。”
妖族血脉与人族特殊圣体不同。
纯阳圣体可以通过后天觉醒，但三足金乌和五爪金龙血脉不行。
通常来说，三足金乌和五爪金龙血脉都是在降生的那一刻，其体内的血脉产生变异、返祖现象，才会觉醒金乌或金龙血脉。
可詹台朵朵却在后天觉醒了。
那就说明，涅盘天凤族定然是使用了什么手段，才让詹台朵朵觉醒了三足金乌血脉。
柳紫嫣不知这个手段是什么，但必然不会是百分百成功。
content_en:
After discussion, Lin Mo and Zhantai Xuankun unanimously decided to wait until Zhantai Xuankun recovered from his injuries before attacking Jinlongtian to carry out the final liquidation of the Ancient True Dragon Clan.
Anyway, the news in the Taiyi Realm cannot spread, and basically all the senior officials of the Taigu True Dragon Clan are dispatched.
Therefore, the news here cannot be transmitted back to Jin Longtian in a short time.
Later, Zhantai Xuankun sent people to clean up the battlefield and harvested many magic weapons, storage rings and other trophies from the powerful ancient True Dragon Clan.
Lin Mo only wanted one trophy.
That was the Holy Dragon Sword, a high-grade holy-level treasure, that Emperor Mahadeva had just used.
This is the most valuable and heaviest trophy of all.
Therefore, Lin Mo didn’t want much.
"There is one thing I still don't understand. What is Tianyuan Palace's intention to attack Duo Duo?" Seeing that Lin Mo really didn't want the spoils, Zhan Tai Xuankun also dismissed the topic and turned to the doubts he and Lin Mo shared.
"I am not the owner of a special holy body, why are they arresting me?" Zhan Taiduoduo himself also looked confused.
"The owner of the three-legged Golden Crow bloodline..."
Liu Ziyan pondered: "Objectively speaking, your Three-legged Golden Crow bloodline is indeed of great value. Maybe they want to use your Three-legged Golden Crow bloodline to refine elixirs, or to refine weapons."
Lin Mo said noncommittally: "The question is, even if the three-legged Golden Crow bloodline can be used to refine elixirs and weapons, is it really worth them sending out three Mahayana-stage powerhouses?"
And one of them was a deceased person in the late Mahayana period.
"Let's discuss this issue later."
Seeing that they could not come up with a result after discussing together, Zhantai Xuankun did not hesitate too much, "Little friend Lin, Head Liu, I have caused trouble to you today. Please come to my Zhantai Mansion to take a rest."
Because of this genocide, the cities of Taiyi Realm were basically destroyed.
Fortunately, Zhantai Mansion was not affected too much.
Therefore, there is still a place for Lin Mo and Liu Ziyan to rest.
After returning to Zhantai Mansion, Lin Mo asked Zhantai Xuankun to recover from his injuries first.
"Fairy Duoduo, you should go and help deal with post-war matters first. This is not the first time I'm here. Zizi and I can just do what we want." Zhan Tai Duoduo originally wanted to entertain Lin Mo and Liu Ziyan on behalf of her father.
But for Lin Mo, with Liu Ziyan by his side, he couldn't act so recklessly.
No matter what, he had to consider Liu Ziyan's feelings.
What's more, Lin Mo still has something to ask Liu Ziyan, so sending Zhan Tai Duoduo away is the best choice.
"Then...Okay, fellow Taoist Lin Mo, Master Liu, if you need anything, just call me. I'll go help first." After receiving the look from Lin Mo, Zhan Taiduoduo immediately understood.
Looking at Zhan Tai Duoduo's retreating back, Liu Ziyan said thoughtfully: "Last time I saw her in Ninghua Palace, she seemed to be of the ordinary Nirvana Tianfeng bloodline, right?"
"I haven't seen her for a while, but this Zhan Tai Duoduo has actually awakened the three-legged Golden Crow bloodline. It seems that she has pretty good luck."
The bloodline of the demon race is different from the special holy body of the human race.
The Pure Yang Holy Body can be awakened the day after tomorrow, but the blood of the three-legged Golden Crow and the five-clawed Golden Dragon cannot.
Generally speaking, the bloodline of the Three-legged Golden Crow and the Five-clawed Golden Dragon will awaken the Golden Crow or Golden Dragon bloodline only when the bloodline in their bodies mutates and returns to their ancestors at the moment of birth.
But Zhan Tai Duoduo woke up the day after tomorrow.
That means that the Nirvana Tianfeng Clan must have used some means to make Zhan Tai Duoduo awaken the three-legged Golden Crow bloodline.
Liu Ziyan didn't know what this method was, but it would definitely not be 100% successful.
